speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID)

The combination of severe lower abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, dysuria, and the history of recent unprotected intercourse with a new partner in a sexually active 17-year-old female is highly suggestive of Pelvic Inflammatory Disease. Do you have any history of previous ectopic pregnancies or tubal surgeries?
